Just a few minutes from the Greek Theater, UC Berkeley, Downtown Berkeley and BART, Chez Panisse and award-winning restaurants, LBL, and plenty more, this spacious studio gets natural light over the course of the day. Facing our neighbor's yard, you may even get to see wildlife passing through.

With a king-sized bed, fireplace heater, nice-sized bathroom, closet, sit/stand desk, Keurig, television, and its own entrance, you can be comfortable whether you are here for business or for pleasure!

The space
With a private entrance and bathroom, this studio is en suite to our house, on the ground level. This is important to note, because it is separate to and below our living space and next to our garage. We are respectful, but please know that you'll hear footsteps or voices periodically. Although there is no kitchen, it has a nice kitchenette equipped with a mini-refrigerator (for potential leftovers), microwave oven (for heating said leftovers), and Keurig machine (for coffee lovers/needers).

If you're concerned about working, the table is adjustable height, and serves as your workstation or table. The bathroom is large, with a nice-size shower. The closet has a tower fan, iron and ironing board, luggage rack, and extra blankets. Whether you're here on business or pleasure, this studio has what you need!

Guest access
The entrance is to the right of our driveway, along our neighbor's open front yard. You'll have access to the unit in its entirety, plus our WiFi is super speedy for folks who need to work remotely!

[It's important to note that there are two steps down from the driveway, which might be difficult to see at night. Please use your phone's flashlight at night.]

Other things to note
-The Unit: Is below our home, so you'll hear our family above.

-The Door: Airbnb will send you the code and our confirmed address about a week or so before your stay. Two days before your visit, we'll send more info about arrival and ask when we should expect you. The day of your stay, we'll update code time if the unit's clean and ready for you before the agreed upon check-in time. Make sure to read through everything so you know just what to do when you get here!

-The Garden: Is our neighbor's yard - please do not walk across the yard! The fruit in it also attracts critters - most often deer and squirrels, but there are others in the neighborhood as well.

-The Hill: We live on a hill that's steep in places, be careful of your step - especially when coming off of the driveway.

-The View: That steep-in-areas hill provides us a tremendous view of the Bay, which is even better from the Rose Garden to our north (if you take our street to the right/north, just past where it meets Euclid).

-The Neighborhood: There are great restaurants, Cal Berkeley, the Greek Theater, a beautiful view of the Bay from the Rose Garden, the Downtown BART station, and so much more within a short walking distance. However, we do live on a hill. Getting downtown is pretty easy (but some might consider the return less fun because, you know, it's uphill). There's not much we can do about it except enjoy the view!

-The Ants: The beauty of living next to such a nice yard is that ants try to find places warm and damp during the wet season. We do what we can to stop them, but appreciate any notification and patience if they start their march indoors.

-The Parking: Is street parking and is free, but has a two-hour limit Monday-Friday from 8.00 am-7.00 pm. We know some spots without the limit and have a limited number of passes, so please reach out if you're leaving your vehicle during the week. And please DO NOT park in the driveway.

From the host
We are in the hills of Berkeley - but those sometimes steep hills afford us amazing views of the Bay and the City. Our neighborhood is quiet; just far enough away from the buzz of the streets below to make them walkable, but high enough to enjoy the views. Plus, the neighborhood is filled with homes that take great care of their gardens. All of this makes it very beautiful throughout the year.

Honestly, we're in a great location about a mile to the Downtown Berkeley and the BART station, a little more than a half-mile from the Greek Theater and the UC Berkeley campus, directly up the hill from the infamous Chez Panisse, original Peet's Coffee, and Cheese Board Pizza, and a half-mile down the hill from the Berkeley Rose Garden for an incredible view of the Bay. We're incredibly lucky to have such a beautiful home, and look forward to sharing it with you!

The space
With a private entrance and bathroom, this studio is en suite to our house, on the ground level. This is important to note, because it is separate to and below our living space and next to our garage. We are respectful, but please know that you'll hear footsteps or voices periodically. Although there is no kitchen, it has a nice kitchenette equipped with a mini-refrigerator (for potential leftovers), microwave oven (for heating said leftovers), and Keurig machine (for coffee lovers/needers).

If you're concerned about working, the table is adjustable height, and serves as your workstation or table. The bathroom is large, with a nice-size shower. The closet is gigantic, where you'll find a tower fan, iron and ironing board, luggage rack, and extra blankets. Whether you're here on business or pleasure, this studio has what you need!

Guest access
You'll have access to the studio, spacious closet, and bathroom. Our WiFi is super speedy for folks who need to work remotely!

Other things to note
-The Unit: Is below our home, so you'll hear our family above.

-The Door: Airbnb will send you the code and our confirmed address about a week or so before your stay. Two days before your visit, we'll send more info about arrival and ask when we should expect you. The day of your stay, we'll update the code time if the unit's clean and ready for you before the agreed upon check-in time. Make sure to read through everything so you know just what to do when you get here!

-The View: The steep-in-areas hill provides us a tremendous view of the Bay, which is even better from the Rose Garden to our north (if you take our street to the right/north, just past where it meets Euclid).

-The Neighborhood: There are great restaurants, Cal Berkeley, the Greek Theater, a beautiful view of the Bay from the Rose Garden, the Downtown BART station, and so much more within a short walking distance. However, we do live on a hill! Getting downtown is pretty easy (but some might consider the return less fun because, you know, it's uphill). There's not much we can do about it except enjoy the view!

-The Parking: Is street parking and is free, but has a two-hour limit Monday-Friday from 8.00 am-7.00 pm. We know some spots without the limit and have a limited number of passes, so please reach out if you're leaving your vehicle during the week. And please DO NOT park in the driveway.

Near much of what makes Berkeley special, like Downtown and BART, UC, Greek Theater, restaurants in the NoSh District (formerly known as the Gourmet Ghetto) like the famed Chez Panisse, Cheeseboard and Cheeseboard Pizza, and original Peet's Coffee, these units are at the same address but are on separate sides of our home. With the same amenities like coded entries, bathrooms, large beds, sit/stand desks, and televisions, they offer their own style and feel. They're great for traveling couples.

The space
One address, two separate units! They are similar in many regards: They're en suite, disconnected units on the ground level of our home (one on the north side, the other on the south) and have the same amenities. However, they have their own flavor and experience.

This is a combined listing of our two units, the Spacious Private Garden Studio and Modern Retro Private Studio, which are below our living area. We are respectful, but please know that you'll hear footsteps or voices periodically (especially during the day when our kids are running around) or might hear us going to the garage.

Also, it is important to note that there is no kitchen, each has a nice kitchenette equipped with a mini-refrigerator (for potential leftovers), microwave oven (for heating said leftovers), and Keurig machine (for coffee lovers/needers).

If you're concerned about working, the tables are adjustable height, serving as your workstation or table and our WiFi is super speedy. The bathrooms are both large, with nice-size showers. The closets both have tower fans, irons and ironing boards, luggage racks, and extra blankets. Whether you're here on business or pleasure, we should have you covered!

Guest access
You'll have access to both studios in their entirety, plus our WiFi is super speedy for folks who need to work remotely! The entrances are on either side of our home and the units do not connect. Also, it's important to note that there are two steps down from the driveway to the entrance to the Spacious Private Garden Studio, which might be difficult to see at night. (Please use your phone's flashlight at night.)

Other things to note
-The Units: Are below our home, so you'll hear our family above.

-The Doors: Airbnb will send you our confirmed address about a week or so before your stay. Two days before your visit, we'll send more info about arrival and ask when we should expect you. The day of your stay, we'll send you the door codes (both will be the same) when the units are clean and ready for you. Make sure to read through everything so you know just what to do when you get here!

-The Garden (in front of the Spacious Private Garden Studio): Is our neighbor's yard - please do not walk across the yard! The fruit in it also attracts critters - most often deer and squirrels, but there are others in the neighborhood as well.

-The Hill: We live on a hill that's steep in places, be careful of your step - especially when coming off of the driveway to go to the Spacious Private Garden Studio on the south side of our home.

-The View: That steep-in-areas hill provides us a tremendous view of the Bay, which is even better from the Rose Garden to our north (if you take our street to the right/north, just past where it meets Euclid).

-The Neighborhood: There are great restaurants, Cal Berkeley, the Greek Theater, a beautiful view of the Bay from the Rose Garden, the Downtown BART station, and so much more within a short walking distance. However, we do live on a hill. Getting downtown is pretty easy (but some might consider the return less fun because, you know, it's uphill). There's not much we can do about it except enjoy the view!

-The Ants: The beauty of living next to such a nice yard (by the Spacious Private Garden Studio) is that ants try to find places warm and damp during the wet season. We do what we can to stop them, but appreciate any notification and patience if they start their march indoors.

-The Parking: Is street parking and is free, but has a two-hour limit Monday-Friday from 8.00 am-7.00 pm. We know some spots without the limit and have a limited number of passes, so please reach out if you're leaving your vehicle during the week. And please DO NOT park in the driveway.

From the host
We are in the hills of Berkeley - but those sometimes steep hills afford us amazing views of the Bay and the City. Our neighborhood is quiet; just far enough away from the buzz of the streets below to make them walkable, but high enough to enjoy the views. Plus, the neighborhood is filled with homes that take great care of their gardens. All of this makes it very beautiful throughout the year.

Honestly, we're in a great location about a mile to the Downtown Berkeley and the BART station, a little more than a half-mile from the Greek Theater and the UC Berkeley campus, directly up the hill from the infamous Chez Panisse, original Peet's Coffee, and Cheese Board Pizza, and a half-mile down the hill from the Berkeley Rose Garden for an incredible view of the Bay. We're incredibly lucky to have such a beautiful home, and look forward to sharing it with you!

I arrived in the Bay in 2011 and met my lovely wife later that year. We are parents to three lovely children, all of whom are energetic, engaging, adventurous, fun, beautiful, and clever. I'm originally from Florida, but lived in Arizona for many years - my favorite sports team reflect this. I've also lived in Mexico and Spain. The travel bug bit me in 2006, and I've traveled to about 20 countries (my oldest has already been to three!). When I'm not working on communication approaches and business strategy, you might find me in the kitchen cooking up a delicious concoction or playing with my girls on the playground. My host approach is similar to what I like when I'm a guest: To be as informative as possible and help visitors know what it's like to live in this amazing area. I prefer holes in the wall to fancy restaurants, but I like to know them all. We're pretty active, in general, and being a half-mile walk from one of the Bay's quintessential views (and a playground right across the street) in the Berkeley Rose Garden is mighty helpful.

A proud neighborhood with great history and friendly neighbors. This is a working class neighborhood with lots of diversity.

The apartment is in a safe, gated building within a multicultural, diverse, ethnic and socio economic area. Neighbors can sometimes be noisy at night, and if you are unfamiliar with city life, I encourage taking a taxi or Uber after dusk.

You may interact with people with different life experiences while walking the neighborhood or using public transit, definitely keep your eyes up and your phone in your pocket. Most of the Bay Area, including Oakland, have many unhoused individuals.
